bg_fg_numel, bg_bg_numel]\n\n        mean_pred_value = pred_fg_numel / self.gt_size\n        mean_gt_value = self.gt_fg_numel / self.gt_size\n\n        demeaned_pred_fg_value = 1 - mean_pred_value\n        demeaned_pred_bg_value = 0 - mean_pred_value\n        demeaned_gt_fg_value = 1 - mean_gt_value\n        demeaned_gt_bg_value = 0 - mean_gt_value\n\n        combinations = [\n            (demeaned_pred_fg_value, demeaned_gt_fg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_fg_value, demeaned_gt_bg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_bg_value, demeaned_gt_fg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_bg_value, demeaned_gt_bg_value),\n        ]\n        return parts_numel, combinations\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about E-measure.\n        :return: dict(em=dict(adp=adaptive_em, curve=changeable_em))\n        \"\"\"\n        adaptive_em = np.mean(np.array(self.adaptive_ems, dtype=_TYPE))\n        changeable_em = np.mean(np.array(self.changeable_ems, dtype=_TYPE), axis=0)\n        return dict(em=dict(adp=adaptive_em, curve=changeable_em))\n\n\nclass WeightedFmeasure(object):\n    def __init__(self, beta: float = 0.3):\n        \"\"\"\n        Weighted F-measure for SOD.\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{wFmeasure,\n                title={How to eval foreground maps?},\n pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the weighted F-measure.\n        \"\"\"\n        # [Dst,IDXT] = bwdist(dGT);\n        Dst, Idxt = bwdist(gt == 0, fg_bg_numel, pred_fg_numel, pred_bg_numel):\n        bg_fg_numel = self.gt_fg_numel - fg_fg_numel\n        bg_bg_numel = pred_bg_numel - bg_fg_numel\n\n        parts_numel = [fg_fg_numel, fg_bg_numel,      demeaned_pred_bg_value = 0 - mean_pred_value\n        demeaned_gt_fg_value = 1 - mean_gt_value\n        demeaned_gt_bg_value = 0 - mean_gt_value\n\n        combinations = [\n            (demeaned_pred_fg_value, demeaned_gt_fg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_fg_value, demeaned_gt_bg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_bg_value, demeaned_gt_fg_value),\n            (demeaned_pred_bg_value, demeaned_gt_bg_value),\n        ]\n        return parts_numel, combinations\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about E-measure.\n        :return: dict(em=dict(adp=adaptive_em, curve=changeable_em))\n        \"\"\"\n        adaptive_em = np.mean(np.array(self.adaptive_ems, dtype=_TYPE))\n        changeable_em = np.mean(np.array(self.changeable_ems, dtype=_TYPE), axis=0)\n        return dict(em=dict(adp=adaptive_em, curve=changeable_em))\n\n\nclass WeightedFmeasure(object):\n    def __init__(self, beta: float = 0.3):\n        \"\"\"\n        Weighted F-measure for SOD.\n        ::\n            @inproceedings{wFmeasure,\n                title={How to eval foreground maps?},\n                author={Margolin, Ran and Zelnik-Manor, Lihi and Tal, Ayellet},\n                booktitle=CVPR,\n                pages={248--255},\n                year={2014}\n            }\n        :param beta: the weight of the precision\n        \"\"\"\n        self.beta = beta\n        self.weighted_fms = []\n\n    def step(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray):\n        pred, gt = _prepare_data(pred=pred, gt=gt)\n\n        if np.all(~gt):\n            wfm = 0\n        else:\n            wfm = self.cal_wfm(pred, gt)\n        self.weighted_fms.append(wfm)\n\n    def cal_wfm(self, pred: np.ndarray, gt: np.ndarray) -&gt; float:\n        \"\"\"\n        Calculate the weighted F-measure.\n        \"\"\"\n        # [Dst,IDXT] = bwdist(dGT);\n        Dst, Idxt = bwdist(gt == 0, return_indices=True)\n\n        # %Pixel dependency\n        # E = abs(FG-dGT);\n        E = np.abs(pred - gt)\n        # Et = E;\n        # Et(~GT)=Et(IDXT(~GT)); %To deal correctly with the edges of the foreground region\n        Et = np.copy(E)\n        Et[gt == 0] = Et[Idxt[0][gt == 0], Idxt[1][gt == 0]]\n\n        # K = fspecial('gaussian',7,5);\n        # EA = imfilter(Et,K);\n        K = self.matlab_style_gauss2D((7, 7), sigma=5)\n        EA = convolve(Et, weights=K, mode=\"constant\", cval=0)\n        # MIN_E_EA = E;\n        # MIN_E_EA(GT &amp; EA&lt;E) = EA(GT &amp; EA&lt;E);\n        MIN_E_EA = np.where(gt &amp; (EA &lt; E), EA, E)\n\n        # %Pixel importance\n        # B = ones(size(GT));\n        # B(~GT) = 2-1*exp(log(1-0.5)/5.*Dst(~GT));\n        # Ew = MIN_E_EA.*B;\n        B = np.where(gt == 0, 2 - np.exp(np.log(0.5) / 5 * Dst), np.ones_like(gt))\n        Ew = MIN_E_EA * B\n\n        # TPw = sum(dGT(:)) - sum(sum(Ew(GT)));\n        # FPw = sum(sum(Ew(~GT)));\n        TPw = np.sum(gt) - np.sum(Ew[gt == 1])\n        FPw = np.sum(Ew[gt == 0])\n\n        # R = 1- mean2(Ew(GT)); %Weighed Recall\n        # P = TPw./(eps+TPw+FPw); %Weighted Precision\n        # 注意这里使用mask索引矩阵的时候不可使用Ew[gt]，这实际上仅在索引Ew的0维度\n        R = 1 - np.mean(Ew[gt == 1])\n        P = TPw / (TPw + FPw + _EPS)\n\n        # % Q = (1+Beta^2)*(R*P)./(eps+R+(Beta.*P));\n        Q = (1 + self.beta) * R * P / (R + self.beta * P + _EPS)\n\n        return Q\n\n    def matlab_style_gauss2D(self, shape: tuple = (7, 7), sigma: int = 5) -&gt; np.ndarray:\n        \"\"\"\n        2D gaussian mask - should give the same result as MATLAB's\n        fspecial('gaussian',[shape],[sigma])\n        \"\"\"\n        m, n = [(ss - 1) / 2 for ss in shape]\n        y, x = np.ogrid[-m : m + 1, -n : n + 1]\n        h = np.exp(-(x * x + y * y) / (2 * sigma * sigma))\n        h[h &lt; np.finfo(h.dtype).eps * h.max()] = 0\n        sumh = h.sum()\n        if sumh != 0:\n            h /= sumh\n        return h\n\n    def get_results(self) -&gt; dict:\n        \"\"\"\n        Return the results about weighted F-measure.\n        :return: dict(wfm=weighted_fm)\n        \"\"\"\n        weighted_fm = np.mean(np.array(self.weighted_fms, dtype=_TYPE))\n        return dict(wfm=weighted_fm)\n\n\nclass Multiclass_IoU(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the IoU for multi-class semantic segmentation based on https://github.com/xieenze/Trans2Seg/blob/master/segmentron/utils/score.py.\n    The direct use of torchmetrics for large dataset will lead to issues such as high CPU usage or insufficient memory.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"total_inter\", default=torch.zeros(num_classes), dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"total_union\", default=torch.zeros(num_classes), dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.num_classes = num_classes\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        inter, union = self.batch_intersection_union(logits, labels)\n        self.total_inter += inter\n        self.total_union += union\n\n    def compute(self):\n        IoU = 1.0 * self.total_inter / (2.220446049250313e-16 + self.total_union)\n        return torch.tensor(IoU.mean().item())\n\n    def batch_intersection_union(self, output, target):\n        mini = 2\n        maxi = self.num_classes\n        nbins = self.num_classes - 1\n        predict = torch.argmax(output, 1) + 1\n        target = target.float() + 1\n\n        predict = predict.float() * (target &gt; 0).float()\n        intersection = predict * (predict == target).float()\n        # areas of intersection and union\n        area_inter = torch.histc(intersection, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_pred = torch.histc(predict, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_lab = torch.histc(target, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_union = area_pred + area_lab - area_inter\n        assert torch.sum(area_inter &gt; area_union).item() == 0, \"Intersection area should be smaller than Union area\"\n        return area_inter.float(), area_union.float()\n\n\nclass Binary_IoU(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the IoU for binary semantic segmentation. The direct use of torchmetrics to calculate IoU for multiple samples does not yield accurate results.\n    So we iteratively calculate metric values and then take the average.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"logits\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"labels\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        self.logits.append(logits)\n        self.labels.append(labels)\n\n    def compute(self):\n        # Handle different image sizes by processing individually instead of concatenating\n        res_list = []\n        metric = torchmetrics.JaccardIndex(task=\"binary\")\n        for logit, label in zip(self.logits, self.labels):\n            # Move to CPU and remove batch dim if present\n            logit = logit.cpu()\n            label = label.cpu()\n            if logit.dim() == 3 and logit.shape[0] == 1:\n                logit = logit.squeeze(0)\n            if label.dim() == 3 and label.shape[0] == 1:\n                label = label.squeeze(0)\n            res_list.append(metric(logit, label))\n        return torch.mean(torch.tensor(res_list))\n\n\nclass Binary_DICE(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the DICE coefficient for binary semantic segmentation.\n    DICE = 2 * |intersection| / (|pred| + |gt|) = 2 * IoU / (1 + IoU)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"logits\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"labels\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        self.logits.append(logits)\n        self.labels.append(labels)\n\n    def compute(self):\n        # Handle different image sizes by processing individually instead of concatenating\n        res_list = []\n        # Compute DICE from IoU: DICE = 2 * IoU / (1 + IoU)\n        iou_metric = torchmetrics.JaccardIndex(task=\"binary\")\n        for logit, label in zip(self.logits, self.labels):\n            # Move to CPU and remove batch dim if present\n            logit = logit.cpu()\n            label = label.cpu()\n            if logit.dim() == 3 and logit.shape[0] == 1:\n                logit = logit.squeeze(0)\n            if label.dim() == 3 and label.shape[0] == 1:\n                label = label.squeeze(0)\n            iou = iou_metric(logit, label)\n            dice = 2 * iou / (1 + iou)\n            res_list.append(dice)\n        return torch.mean(torch.tensor(res_list))\n\n\nclass Multiclass_DICE(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the DICE coefficient for multi-class semantic segmentation.\n    前景宏平均（不含背景）；实现方式对齐 ABD：逐类二值化后算二值 Dice 再取平均。\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.num_classes = num_classes\n        self.add_state(\"dice_sum\", default=torch.tensor(0.0), dist_reduce_fx=\"sum\")\n        self.add_state(\"class_count\", default=torch.tensor(0.0), dist_reduce_fx=\"sum\")\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        # logits: [B, C, H, W] (概率/Logits 均可，取 argmax 得到预测类别)\n        # labels: [B, H, W]，取值 0..C-1，背景=0\n        pred = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1)\n        gt = labels.long()\n\n        dice_sum, cls_cnt = self._dice_per_class(pred, gt)\n        self.dice_sum += dice_sum\n        self.class_count += cls_cnt\n\n    def compute(self):\n        if self.class_count.item() == 0:\n            return torch.tensor(0.0)\n        return self.dice_sum / self.class_count\n\n    def _dice_per_class(self, pred, gt):\n        \"\"\"\n        对每个前景类 c=1..C-1 计算二值 Dice，再对有效类求平均（宏平均）。\n        若某类 pred+gt 均为 0，则跳过该类。\n        \"\"\"\n        dice_sum = pred.new_tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32)\n        cls_cnt = pred.new_tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32)\n        for c in range(1, self.num_classes):\n            pred_c = (pred == c)\n            gt_c = (gt == c)\n            denom = pred_c.sum().float() + gt_c.sum().float()\n            if denom &gt; 0:\n                inter = (pred_c &amp; gt_c).sum().float()\n                dice_c = 2.0 * inter / denom\n                dice_sum += dice_c\n                cls_cnt += 1.0\n        return dice_sum, cls_cnt\n\n\nclass Balanced_Error_Rate(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the balanced error rate.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"logits\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"labels\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        self.logits.append(logits)\n        self.labels.append(labels)\n\n    def compute(self):\n        logits = torch.cat(self.logits).cpu()\n        labels = torch.cat(self.labels).cpu()\n\n        labels = (labels * 255) &gt; 125\n        logits = (logits * 255) &gt; 125\n        ber = 1 - torchmetrics.Accuracy(\n            task=\"multiclass\", num_classes=2, average=\"macro\", multidim_average=\"samplewise\"\n        )(logits, labels)\n        return torch.mean(ber)\n\n\nclass COD(torchmetrics.Metric):\n    def __init__(self):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.add_state(\"logits\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n        self.add_state(\"labels\", default=[], dist_reduce_fx=None)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        self.logits.append(logits)\n        self.labels.append(labels)\n\n    def compute(self):\n        pass\n\n\nclass SM(COD):\n    def compute(self):\n        logits = torch.cat(self.logits)\n        labels = torch.cat(self.labels)\n        assert logits.shape == labels.shape\n        batchsize = labels.shape[0]\n\n        metric_SM = Smeasure()\n\n        for i in range(batchsize):\n            true, pred = labels[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255, logits[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255\n            metric_SM.step(pred=pred, gt=true)\n\n        return torch.tensor(metric_SM.get_results()[\"sm\"])\n\n\nclass FM(COD):\n    def compute(self):\n        logits = torch.cat(self.logits)\n        labels = torch.cat(self.labels)\n        assert logits.shape == labels.shape\n        batchsize = labels.shape[0]\n\n        metric_WFM = WeightedFmeasure()\n        for i in range(batchsize):\n            true, pred = labels[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255, logits[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255\n\n            metric_WFM.step(pred=pred, gt=true)\n\n        return torch.tensor(metric_WFM.get_results()[\"wfm\"])\n\n\nclass EM(COD):\n    def compute(self):\n        logits = torch.cat(self.logits)\n        labels = torch.cat(self.labels)\n        assert logits.shape == labels.shape\n        batchsize = labels.shape[0]\n\n        metric_EM = Emeasure()\n\n        for i in range(batchsize):\n            true, pred = labels[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255, logits[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255\n\n            metric_EM.step(pred=pred, gt=true)\n\n        return torch.tensor(metric_EM.get_results()[\"em\"][\"curve\"].mean())\n\n\nclass MAE(COD):\n    def compute(self):\n        logits = torch.cat(self.logits)\n        labels = torch.cat(self.labels)\n        assert logits.shape == labels.shape\n        batchsize = labels.shape[0]\n\n        metric_MAE = MAE_SOD()\n        for i in range(batchsize):\n            true, pred = labels[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255, logits[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255\n\n            metric_MAE.step(pred=pred, gt=true)\n\n        return torch.tensor(metric_MAE.get_results()[\"mae\"])\n\n\nCOD_METRICS_NAMES = {\"sm\": SM(), \"fm\": FM(), \"em\": EM(), \"mae\": MAE()}\n\n\n# TODO: Modify multi-gpu evaluation error. Maybe there will be a more elegant way.\nclass Multiclass_IoU_Pred:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the IoU for multi-class semantic segmentation based on https://github.com/xieenze/Trans2Seg/blob/master/segmentron/utils/score.py.\n    The direct use of torchmetrics for large dataset will lead to issues such as high CPU usage or insufficient memory.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.total_inter = torch.zeros(num_classes)\n        self.total_union = torch.zeros(num_classes)\n        self.num_classes = num_classes\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        inter, union = self.batch_intersection_union(logits, labels)\n        self.total_inter += inter\n        self.total_union += union\n\n    def compute(self):\n        IoU = 1.0 * self.total_inter / (2.220446049250313e-16 + self.total_union)\n        return torch.tensor(IoU.mean().item())\n\n    def batch_intersection_union(self, output, target):\n        mini = 2\n        maxi = self.num_classes\n        nbins = self.num_classes - 1\n        predict = torch.argmax(output, 1)\n        target = target.float()\n\n        predict_fg = predict + 1\n        target_fg = target + 1\n        bg_mask = target == 0\n        predict_fg[bg_mask] = 0\n        target_fg[bg_mask] = 0\n\n        intersection = predict_fg * (predict_fg == target_fg).float()\n        area_inter = torch.histc(intersection, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_pred = torch.histc(predict_fg, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_lab = torch.histc(target_fg, bins=nbins, min=mini, max=maxi)\n        area_union = area_pred + area_lab - area_inter\n        assert torch.sum(area_inter &gt; area_union).item() == 0, \"Intersection area should be smaller than Union area\"\n        return area_inter.float(), area_union.float()\n\n\nclass Binary_IoU_Pred:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the IoU for binary semantic segmentation. The direct use of torchmetrics to calculate IoU for multiple samples does not yield accurate results.\n    So we iteratively calculate metric values and then take the average.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        # Use running aggregation to avoid storing all logits/labels in memory\n        self.metric = torchmetrics.JaccardIndex(task=\"binary\")\n        self.total = 0.0\n        self.count = 0\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        # Process each sample immediately to avoid accumulating tensors\n        logits = logits.cpu()\n        labels = labels.cpu()\n        if logits.dim() == 3 and logits.shape[0] == 1:\n            logits = logits.squeeze(0)\n        if labels.dim() == 3 and labels.shape[0] == 1:\n            labels = labels.squeeze(0)\n        iou = self.metric(logits, labels)\n        self.total += float(iou)\n        self.count += 1\n\n    def compute(self):\n        if self.count == 0:\n            return torch.tensor(0.0)\n        return torch.tensor(self.total / self.count)\n\n\nclass Binary_DICE_Pred:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the DICE coefficient for binary semantic segmentation.\n    DICE = 2 * |intersection| / (|pred| + |gt|) = 2 * IoU / (1 + IoU)\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n    ):\n        super().__init__()\n        # Use running labels)\n        dice = 2 * iou / (1 + iou)\n        self.total += float(dice)\n        self.count += 1\n\n    def compute(self):\n        if self.count == 0:\n            return torch.tensor(0.0)\n        return torch.tensor(self.total / self.count)\n\n\nclass Multiclass_DICE_Pred:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the DICE coefficient for multi-class semantic segmentation.\n    前景宏平均（不含背景）；实现方式对齐 ABD：逐类二值化后算二值 Dice 再取平均。\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n        super().__init__()\n        self.num_classes = num_classes\n        self.dice_sum = torch.tensor(0.0)\n        self.class_count = torch.tensor(0.0)\n\n    def update(self, logits, labels):\n        # logits: [B, C, H, W] (概率/Logits 均可，取 argmax 得到预测类别)\n        # labels: [B, H, W]，取值 0..C-1，背景=0\n        pred = dice_sum = pred.new_tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32)\n        cls_cnt = pred.new_tensor(0.0, dtype=torch.float32)\n        for c in range(1, self.num_classes):\n            pred_c = (pred == c)\n            gt_c = (gt == c)\n            denom = pred_c.sum().float() + gt_c.sum().float()\n            if denom &gt; 0:\n                inter = (pred_c &amp; gt_c).sum().float()\n                dice_c = 2.0 * inter / denom\n                dice_sum += dice_c\n                cls_cnt += 1.0\n        return dice_sum, cls_cnt\n\n\nclass Balanced_Error_Rate_Pred:\n    \"\"\"\n    Compute the balanced    batchsize = logits.shape[0]\n        for i in range(batchsize):\n            true = labels[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255\n            pred = logits[i, 0].cpu().data.numpy() * 255\n 已将多分类 Dice 改为与 ABD 相同的逐类二值 Dice 宏平均（不再用 histc），覆盖验证和测试两条路径：

- `Multiclass_DICE`（torchmetrics Metric）
- `Multiclass_DICE_Pred`（流式/预测用）

核心逻辑：`argmax` 得到类别后，对每个前景类 c=1..C-1 做二值 Dice（若该类 pred+gt 皆为 0 则跳过），把有效类的 Dice 求平均。
```python
dice_sum = 0; cls_cnt = 0
for c in range(1, num_classes):
    pred_c = (pred == c); gt_c = (gt == c)
    denom = pred_c.sum() + gt_c.sum()
    if denom > 0:
        inter = (pred_c & gt_c).sum()
        dice_c = 2 * inter / denom
        dice_sum += dice_c; cls_cnt += 1
return dice_sum / cls_cnt if cls_cnt>0 else 0
```

---

### 结论：ABD 用的是**半监督（Semi-supervised）**分割，而不是纯全监督  
它的核心特征是：**少量有标签样本 + 大量无标签样本**，训练时用 **TwoStreamBatchSampler** 在同一 batch 内同时采样 labeled/unlabeled；对无标签样本通过 **伪标签（pseudo-label）/互教（cross-teaching）/EMA teacher** 等产生监督信号（常见的 consistency / pseudo supervision）。

---

### 证据 1：显式区分 labeled / unlabeled，并用 TwoStreamBatchSampler 混合采样
以 `train_ACDC_Cross_Teaching.py` 为例，先用 `patients_to_slices()` 决定 “labeled_slice”，再把剩余切片当作 unlabeled，并用 `TwoStreamBatchSampler` 采样：

```133:140:ABD/code/train_ACDC_Cross_Teaching.py
total_slices = len(db_train)
labeled_slice = patients_to_slices(args.root_path, args.labeled_num)  # args.labeled_num=7
...
labeled_idxs = list(range(0, labeled_slice))
unlabeled_idxs = list(range(labeled_slice, total_slices))
batch_sampler = TwoStreamBatchSampler(labeled_idxs, unlabeled_idxs, batch_size, batch_size - args.labeled_bs)
trainloader = DataLoader(db_train, batch_sampler=batch_sampler, ...)
```

同样的 labeled/unlabeled 划分与采样也出现在 BCP 的 self-train 阶段：

```317:324:ABD/code/train_ACDC_BCP.py
total_slices = len(db_train)
labeled_slice = patients_to_slices(args.root_path,args.labelnum)
...
labeled_idxs = list(range(0, labeled_slice))
unlabeled_idxs = list(range(labeled_slice, total_slices))
batch_sampler = TwoStreamBatchSampler(labeled_idxs, unlabeled_idxs, args.batch_size, args.batch_size-args.labeled_bs)
```

---

### 证据 2（Cross Teaching）：两模型互相给无标签样本提供伪标签监督
脚本里明确把 batch 切成 `[:labeled_bs]` 和 `[labeled_bs:]`，并在无标签部分用**对方模型的 argmax 伪标签**做 DiceLoss（pseudo supervision）：

```168:214:ABD/code/train_ACDC_Cross_Teaching.py
outputs1 = model1(volume_batch)
pseudo_outputs1 = torch.argmax(outputs_soft1[args.labeled_bs:].detach(), dim=1, keepdim=False)

outputs2 = model2(volume_batch_strong)
pseudo_outputs2 = torch.argmax(outputs_soft2[args.labeled_bs:].detach(), dim=1, keepdim=False)

loss1 = 0.5 * (ce_loss(outputs1[:args.lf...], ...) + dice_loss(outputs_soft1[:args.labeled_bs], ...))
loss2 = 0.5 * (ce_loss(outputs2[:args.labeled_bs], ...) + dice_loss(outputs_soft2[:args.labeled_bs], ...))

pseudo_supervision1 = dice_loss(outputs_soft1[args.labeled_bs:], pseudo_outputs2.unsqueeze(1))
pseudo_supervision2 = dice_loss(outputs_soft2[args.labeled_bs:], pseudo_outputs1.unsqueeze(1))

consistency_weight = get_current_consistency_weight(...)
model1_loss = ... + consistency_weight * (pseudo_supervision1 + ...)
model2_loss = ... + consistency_weight * (pseudo_supervision2 + ...)
```

这就是典型的**半监督互教/一致性 + 伪标签监督**范式。

---

### 证据 3（BCP）：先“预训练”（有标签内混合），再“自训练”（EMA teacher + 互伪标签）
BCP 脚本分两段：

- **pre_train**：主要在 labeled 子集内部做 mask mix（类似 CutMix）来训练（仍属于监督学习，但仅用 labeled 部分）：

```234:245:ABD/code/train_ACDC_BCP.py
img_a, img_b = volume_batch[:labeled_sub_bs], volume_batch[labeled_sub_bs:args.labeled_bs]
lab_a, lab_b = label_batch[:labeled_sub_bs], label_batch[labeled_sub_bs:args.labeled_bs]
...
out_mixl = model(net_input)
loss_dice, loss_ce = mix_loss(out_mixl, lab_a, lab_b, loss_mask, u_weight=1.0, unlab=True)
```

- **self_train**：引入 `ema_model` 给 unlabeled 图生成伪标签 `plab_*`，并进行两模型的 cross pseudo supervision：

```305:312:ABD/code/train_ACDC_BCP.py
model_1 = BCP_net(...)
model_2 = BCP_net(...)
ema_model = BCP_net(..., ema=True)
...
db_train = BaseDataSets(..., transform=...WeakStrongAugment...)
```

```364:373:ABD/code/train_ACDC_BCP.py
with torch.no_grad():
    pre_a = ema_model(uimg_a)
    pre_b = ema_model(uimg_b)
    plab_a = get_ACDC_masks(pre_a, nms=1)
    plab_b = get_ACDC_masks(pre_b, nms=1)
```

```410:427:ABD/code/train_ACDC_BCP.py
pseudo_supervision1 = dice_loss(out_soft_1, out_pseudo_2.unsqueeze(1))
pseudo_supervision2 = dice_loss(out_soft_2, out_pseudo_1.unsqueeze(1))
...
loss_1 = (loss_dice_1 + loss_ce_1) / 2 + pseudo_supervision1 + pseudo_supervision3
loss_2 = (loss_dice_2 + loss_ce_2) / 2 + pseudo_supervision2 + pseudo_supervision4
```

这属于**半监督自训练（teacher/EMA 伪标签） + 互教**的组合。

---

### 总结一句话
ABD 的监督方法不是全监督，而是**半监督语义分割**：用少量标注切片做 CE+Dice 的监督学习，同时对大量无标签切片用 **伪标签（来自另一模型或 EMA teacher）+ 一致性/互教损失**提供监督信号。

**没有。**`run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py` 这套“半监督”实现里**不包含 EMA teacher，也不包含 ABD 那种 Cross Training / Cross Teaching（两模型互教伪标签）**。

### 为什么能确定
- **训练只构建了一个 `MultiModalPredictor`**，没有第二个 student/teacher 模型、更没有 teacher 的 EMA 更新逻辑（ABD 里常见的 `ema_model` / `update_ema_variables` / `pseudo_supervision` 在这里都不存在）：

```494:503:autogluon/examples/automm/Conv-LoRA/run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py
predictor = MultiModalPredictor(
    problem_type="semantic_segmentation",
    validation_metric=validation_metric,
    eval_metric=validation_metric,
    ...
)
```

- 实际半监督逻辑是在训练时把数据划分成 **labeled 子集 + unlabeled 子集**，然后对 unlabeled 子集施加**弱监督盒约束损失**（outside-box 背景约束、inside-box 熵最小化、TV 等），这是 **semi/weak supervision**，不是 pseudo-label 的 teacher/student 体系：

```447:466:autogluon/multimodal/src/autogluon/multimodal/optim/lit_semantic_seg.py
semi_labeled_fraction = float(cfg.get("semi_labeled_fraction", 1.0))
...
if self.training and semi_labeled_fraction < 1.0:
    labeled_mask = self._get_labeled_mask_from_paths(...)
```

总结一句话：它的半监督是 **“部分精确 mask + 其余样本用 box 弱约束（弱监督）”**，而不是 **“EMA teacher/双模型互教伪标签（cross training）”**。

 autogluon/examples/automm/Conv-LoRA 中的 run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py 训练所用的方法，有没有包含EMA teacher或Cross Training?

---

_**Agent (model gpt-5.2, mode Agent)**_

**没有。**

### 不含 EMA teacher 的依据
在 `run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py` 里训练只创建了**一个** `MultiModalPredictor`，没有像 ABD 那样额外创建 `ema_model`、也没有 `update_ema_variables / update_model_ema` 之类的参数滑动平均更新逻辑：

```494:503:autogluon/examples/automm/Conv-LoRA/run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py
predictor = MultiModalPredictor(
    problem_type="semantic_segmentation",
    ...
)
```

### 不含 Cross Training（双模型互教/交叉伪标签）的依据
训练代码与底层 `SemanticSegmentationLitModule` 里也没有“model1/model2 两套网络互相生成 pseudo label”的分支；相反，它的半监督来自 **labeled 子集用全监督 loss + unlabeled 子集用 box 弱监督损失**（outside-box 背景约束、inside-box 熵最小化等）：

```463:467:autogluon/multimodal/src/autogluon/multimodal/optim/lit_semantic_seg.py
if self.training and semi_labeled_fraction < 1.0:
    labeled_mask = self._get_labeled_mask_from_paths(...)
```

所以 `run_acdc_conv_lora_semi.py` 的方法**不属于** ABD 那种 EMA teacher / cross-teaching，而是**半监督 + 弱监督（box constraint）**的单模型训练。

_**User (2026-01-12 01:28Z)**_

那么怎样把EMA teacher方法应用于ConvLoRA的半监督训练呢？请仔细分析

---

_**Agent (model gpt-5.1-codex-max, mode Agent)**_

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
**Outlining minimal EMA integration**

Planning a concise approach to maintain an EMA copy, update it during training, and use it for pseudo labels, suggesting minimal invasive changes inside the training module or as an external script.</details></think>

---

可以做法（思路与 ABD 类似），核心是“单模型参数的指数滑动平均 + 用 EMA 输出给无标签样本生成伪标签/一致性信号”。建议分两步改造：

1) 在训练入口/learner 中维护一份 EMA 模型  
- 初始化：在构建 `MultiModalPredictor` 后，拷贝一份 `ema_model = deepcopy(predictor._learner._model)`（或在 `SemanticSegmentationLitModule` 里新增 `ema_model` 成员）。  
- 更新：每个训练 step 后执行 `ema_param = α * ema_param + (1-α) * param`，α 通常 0.99~0.999，前期可用 warmup 按 step 动态调整。  
- 注意关闭 `ema_model` 的梯度，放在 eval 模式。

2) 用 EMA 模型给无标签子集生成伪标签 / 一致性约束  
- 在 `_shared_step` 中已有 `labeled_mask` 区分有/无标签。对 `~labeled_mask` 的样本，用 `ema_model` 前向得到预测：  
  - 若用伪标签（硬标签）：`pseudo = argmax(softmax(ema_logits))`，再用 Dice/CE 监督当前学生的输出。  
  - 若用一致性（软标签/温度）：`p_teacher = softmax(ema_logits / T)`，学生输出 `p_student`，用 MSE 或 KL 做一致性损失。  
- 与现有弱盒损失组合：  
  - 可以“并行”叠加：无标签样本既算盒弱监督（outside/entropy/TV），又算 EMA 一致性/伪标签（二者权重可调）。  
  - 或在有伪标签时关闭盒约束，避免冲突。  
- 权重：引入 `--ema_decay`、`--consistency_weight` 等超参（可用 ramp-up 随训练步数从 0 增大）。

落地建议（代码改动点）：  
- 文件：`autogluon/multimodal/src/autogluon/multimodal/optim/lit_semantic_seg.py`  
  - 在 `__init__` 接收 `ema_model=None, ema_decay=0.99`。  
  - 在 `training_step` 结尾添加 EMA 更新函数。

Starting full evaluation...\\n\")\n        \n        # ============================================================\n        # 方案 2: 断点续传机制\n        # ============================================================\n        import os\n        import pickle\n        \n        # Setup cache directory\n        processed_indices = set()\n        all_preds = []\n        all_labels = []\n        cache_file = None\n        processed_indices_file = None\n        \n        if cache_dir is not None:\n            os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True)\n            cache_file = os.path.join(cache_dir, \"tta_predictions.pkl\")\n            processed_indices_file = os.path.join(cache_dir, \"processed_indices.txt\")\n            \n            # Try to load cached data\n            if resume_from_cache and os.path.exists(cache_file):\n                try:\n                    logger.info(f\"📂 Loading cached predictions from {cache_file}\")\n                    with open(cache_file, 'rb') as f:\n                        cache_data = pickle.load(f)\n                        all_preds = cache_data['preds']\n                        all_labels = cache_data['labels']\n                        processed_indices = set(cache_data['indices'])\n                    logger.info(f\"✅ Loaded {len(all_preds)} cached predictions (resuming from checkpoint)\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    logger.warning(f\"⚠️  Failed to load cache: {e}. Starting fresh.\")\n                    processed_indices = set()\n                    all_preds = []\n                    all_labels = []\n            else:\n                if cache_dir:\n                    logger.info(f\"💾 Caching enabled. Predictions will be saved to {cache_dir}\")\n        \n        # Initialize metrics early so we can stream updates and avoid storing all predictions\n        metric_objects = {}\n        if isinstance(metrics, str):\n            metrics = [metrics]\n        for per_metric_name in metrics:\n            metric_objects[per_metric_name] = get_metric_predict(\n                metric_name=per_metric_name.lower(),\n                num_classes=self._output_shape\n            )\n\n        # Determine whether to stream metrics (no caching =&gt; no large tensors kept)\n        streaming_metrics = cache_dir is None\n\n        # Process each image with TTA\n        import time\n        import gc\n        start_time = time.time()\n        total_images = len(data)\n\n        for idx, row in data.iterrows():\n            # ⭐ 跳过已处理的样本（断点续传）\n            if idx in processed_indices:\n                logger.info(f\"⏭️  Skipping image {idx+1}/{total_images} (already processed)\")\n                continue\n\n            img_start = time.time()\n\n            # Load image and label\n            image_path = row['image']\n            label_path = row['label'] if 'label' in row else None\n\n            # Load image with proper resource management\n            img_pil = Image.open(image_path)\n            image = np.array(img_pil)\n            img_pil.close()  # Release file handle\n\n            if len(image.shape) == 2:\n                image = np.stack([image] * 3, axis=2)  # Convert grayscale to RGB\n\n            # Load label if exists\n            label = None\n            gt_box = None\n            if label_path:\n                label_pil = Image.open(label_path)\n                label = np.array(label_pil)\n                label_pil.close()  # Release file handle\n\n                if len(label.shape) == 3:\n                    label = label[:, :, 0]  # Take first channel if RGB\n\n                # Binarize label: convert [0, 255] to [0, 1]\n                # This matches the preprocessing in semantic_seg_metrics.py\n                if self._output_shape == 1:  # Binary segmentation\n                    label = (label &gt; 128).astype(np.int64)\n\n                if not streaming_metrics:\n                    all_labels.append(torch.from_numpy(label))\n\n                # Compute GT bounding box (single box per sample, original coords)\n                ys, xs = np.where(label &gt; 0)\n                if xs.size &gt; 0 and ys.size &gt; 0:\n                    gt_box = np.array([xs.min(), ys.min(), xs.max(), ys.max()], dtype=np.float32)\n\n            # If predicted boxes are provided in DataFrame, override gt_box\n            if {\"bbox_x1\", \"bbox_y1\", \"bbox_x2\", \"bbox_y2\"}.issubset(row.index):\n                vals = [row[\"bbox_x1\"], row[\"bbox_y1\"], row[\"bbox_x2\"], row[\"bbox_y2\"]]\n                if not any([v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v)) for v in vals]):\n                    gt_box = np.array(vals, dtype=np.float32)\n\n            # Predict with TTA\n            if self._output_shape == 1:\n                # Binary segmentation\n                pred_mask, pred_prob = self._tta_predictor.predict_with_tta(\n                    image, predict_fn, return_probs=True, box_prompt=gt_box, box_ref_shape=image.shape[:2]\n                )\n                pred_tensor = torch.from_numpy(pred_prob)\n                if not streaming_metrics:\n                    # Store only when caching/resume is enabled\n                    all_preds.append(pred_tensor)\n                # Free memory\n                del pred_mask, pred_prob\n            else:\n                # Multi-class segmentation\n                _, pred_prob = self._tta_predictor.predict_with_tta(\n                    image, predict_fn, return_probs=True, box_prompt=gt_box, box_ref_shape=image.shape[:2]\n                )\n                pred_tensor = torch.from_numpy(pred_prob)\n                if not streaming_metrics:\n                    all_preds.append(pred_tensor)\n                # Free memory\n                del pred_prob\n\n            # Stream metric updates to avoid holding all predictions in memory\n            if streaming_metrics:\n                y_p = pred_tensor.float()\n                if label is None:\n                    raise ValueError(\"Labels are required for evaluation\")\n                y_t = torch.from_numpy(label)\n                y_t = y_t.long() if y_t.dtype != torch.long else y_t\n\n                # Resize prediction to match label size if needed\n                if y_p.shape[-2:] != y_t.shape[-2:]:\n                    target_size = y_t.shape[-2:]\n                    y_p = F.interpolate(\n                        y_p.unsqueeze(0),\n                        size=target_size,\n                        mode='bilinear',\n                        align_corners=False\n                    ).squeeze(0)\n\n                for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                    metric_obj.update(y_p.unsqueeze(0), y_t.unsqueeze(0))\n\n            # Free image and label memory\n            del image\n            if label is not None:\n                del label\n\n            # ⭐ 标记为已处理（断点续传）\n            processed_indices.add(idx)\n\n            img_time = time.time() - img_start\n\n            if idx == 0:\n                logger.info(f\"First image processed in {img_time:.2f}s (includes warmup)\")\n\n            # ⭐ 定期保存缓存（每 10 张图或最后一张）\n            num_processed = len(processed_indices)\n            if (not streaming_metrics) and cache_file is not None and (num_processed % 10 == 0 or num_processed == total_images):\n                try:\n                    logger.info(f\"💾 Saving checkpoint ({num_processed}/{total_images} images)\")\n                    with open(cache_file, 'wb') as f:\n                        pickle.dump({\n                            'preds': all_preds,\n                            'labels': all_labels,\n                            'indices': list(processed_indices)\n                        }, f)\n\n                    # Save processed indices as text file (for easy inspection)\n                    with open(processed_indices_file, 'w') as f:\n                        f.write('\\n'.join(map(str, sorted(processed_indices))))\n\n                    logger.info(f\"✅ Checkpoint saved successfully\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    logger.warning(f\"⚠️  Failed to save checkpoint: {e}\")\n\n            # More aggressive garbage collection to prevent memory leaks\n            if (idx + 1) % 5 == 0:  # Every 5 images instead of 10\n                gc.collect()  # Force garbage collection\n                if torch.cuda.is_available():\n                    torch.cuda.empty_cache()  # Clear GPU cache\n\n            # Progress logging\n            if (idx + 1) % 10 == 0 or num_processed == total_images:\n                elapsed = time.time() - start_time\n                avg_time = elapsed / num_processed if num_processed &gt; 0 else 0\n                remaining = total_images - num_processed\n                eta = avg_time * remaining if remaining &gt; 0 else 0\n                logger.info(\n                    f\"Processed {num_processed}/{total_images} images with TTA \"\n                    f\"(avg: {avg_time:.2f}s/img, ETA: {eta/60:.1f}min)\"\n                )\n\n                # ⭐ 中间指标：在评估过程中周期性输出当前已处理样本的指标\n                # 说明：\n                # - 仅在 streaming_metrics=True（即未开启 cache_dir，走低内存流式评估）时启用\n                # - 使用 torchmetrics.compute() 不会清空内部状态，因此可以安全多次调用\n                if streaming_metrics:\n                    try:\n                        intermediate_results = {}\n                        for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                            score = metric_obj.compute()\n                            # score 可能是 tensor 或数值，这里统一为 float 便于日志展示\n                            if hasattr(score, \"item\"):\n                                score = score.item()\n                            intermediate_results[metric_name] = float(score)\n                        if intermediate_results:\n                            logger.info(\n                                f\"Intermediate TTA metrics after {num_processed} images: \"\n                                f\"{intermediate_results}\"\n                            )\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        logger.warning(f\"Failed to compute intermediate metrics: {e}\")\n        \n        # Final garbage collection\n        gc.collect()\n        if torch.cuda.is_available():\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n\n        logger.info(f\"Finished processing all {len(data)} images, computing metrics...\")\n\n        results = {}\n        if streaming_metrics:\n            # Metrics were updated on the fly; just compute\n            for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                score = metric_obj.compute()\n                results[metric_name] = score.item()\n        else:\n            # Check that we have predictions and labels\n            if len(all_labels) == 0:\n                raise ValueError(\"Labels are required for evaluation\")\n            \n            if len(all_preds) != len(all_labels):\n                raise ValueError(f\"Number of predictions ({len(all_preds)}) != number of labels ({len(all_labels)})\")\n\n            # Process each image individually (can't stack due to different sizes)\n            for y_p, y_t in zip(all_preds, all_labels):\n                # Ensure predictions and labels are on CPU and have matching sizes\n                y_p = y_p.float()\n                y_t = y_t.long() if y_t.dtype != torch.long else y_t\n                \n                # Resize prediction to match label size if needed\n                if y_p.shape[-2:] != y_t.shape[-2:]:\n                    target_size = y_t.shape[-2:]\n                    y_p = F.interpolate(\n                        y_p.unsqueeze(0),  # Add batch dim\n                        size=target_size,\n                        mode='bilinear',\n                        align_corners=False\n                    ).squeeze(0)  # Remove batch dim\n                \n                # Update all metrics with this image\n                for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                    metric_obj.update(y_p.unsqueeze(0), y_t.unsqueeze(0))\n\n            # Compute final scores\n            for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                score = metric_obj.compute()\n                results[metric_name] = score.item()\n\n        logger.info(f\"TTA evaluation completed: {results}\")\n        \n        # ⭐ 清理缓存文件（评估成功完成后）\n        if cache_file is not None and os.path.exists(cache_file):\n            try:\n                os.remove(cache_file)\n                if processed_indices_file and os.path.exists(processed_indices_file):\n                    os.remove(processed_indices_file)\n                logger.info(f\"🗑️  Cleaned up cache files (evaluation completed successfully)\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.warning(f\"⚠️  Failed to clean up cache: {e}\")\n        \n        # Free memory\n        del all_preds, all_labels, metric_objects\n        gc.collect()\n        if torch.cuda.is_available():\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n        \n        if return_pred:\n            logger.warning(\"return_pred=True not fully supported with TTA (memory optimization)\")\n            return results, []\n        else:\n            return results\n\n    def get_litmodule_per_run(\n        self,\n        model=None,\n        model_postprocess_fn=None,\n        peft_param_names=None,\n        optim_kwargs=None,\n        distillation_kwargs=None,\n        is_train=True,\n    ):\n        gspo_trainer = None\n        if is_train:\n            gspo_trainer = self._maybe_create_gspo_trainer()\n        if is_train:\n            return SemanticSegmentationLitModule(\n                model=model,\n                model_postprocess_fn=model_postprocess_fn,\n                trainable_param_names=peft_param_names,\n                gspo_trainer=gspo_trainer,\n                train_box_prompt_cfg=self._train_box_prompt_cfg,\n                train_bbox_predictor=self._train_bbox_predictor,\n                **optim_kwargs,\n            )\n        else:\n            return SemanticSegmentationLitModule(\n                model=self._model,\n                model_postprocess_fn=self._model_postprocess_fn,\n                train_box_prompt_cfg=self._train_box_prompt_cfg,\n                train_bbox_predictor=self._train_bbox_predictor,\n                **optim_kwargs,\n            )\n\n    def _maybe_create_gspo_trainer(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Auto-create GSPO trainer if the config enables GSPO.\n        The trainer implementation lives in examples/automm/Conv-LoRA/gspo_trainer.py.\n        \"\"\"\n        if self._config is None:\n            return None\n\n        lora_cfg = getattr(self._config.optim, \"lora\", None)\n        if not lora_cfg or not getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_enabled\", False):\n            return None\n\n        gspo_cfg = getattr(self._config.optim, \"gspo\", None)\n        lambda_smooth = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"lambda_smooth\", 0.1) if gspo_cfg else 0.1\n        lambda_boundary = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"lambda_boundary\", 0.3) if gspo_cfg else 0.3\n        w_boundary = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"w_boundary\", 0.3) if gspo_cfg else 0.3\n        w_smooth = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"w_smooth\", 0.1) if gspo_cfg else 0.1\n        w_thin = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"w_thin\", 0.05) if gspo_cfg else 0.05\n\n        # Dynamically load GSPOConvLoRATrainer from examples path.\n        examples_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / \"examples\" / \"automm\" / \"Conv-LoRA\" / \"gspo_trainer.py\"\n        if not examples_root.exists():\n            logger.warning(\"GSPO is enabled but gspo_trainer.py not found at %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", examples_root)\n            return None\n\n        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"autogluon_multimodal.gspo_trainer\", examples_root)\n        if spec is None or spec.loader is None:\n            logger.warning(\"Failed to load GSPO trainer spec from %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", examples_root)\n            return None\n        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n        spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore\n        GSPOConvLoRATrainer = getattr(module, \"GSPOConvLoRATrainer\", None)\n        if GSPOConvLoRATrainer is None:\n            logger.warning(\"GSPOConvLoRATrainer not found in %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", examples_root)\n            return None\n\n        # Get GSPO-Adapter parameters (if available)\n        sam_cfg = getattr(self._config.model, \"sam\", None)\n        gspo_adapter_enabled = getattr(sam_cfg, \"adapter_gspo_enabled\", False) if sam_cfg else False\n        gspo_adapter_momentum = getattr(sam_cfg, \"adapter_gspo_momentum\", 0.9) if sam_cfg else 0.9\n        \n        # Get GSPO-LoRA on Attention parameters (if available) - NEW\n        gspo_lora_attention_enabled = getattr(sam_cfg, \"gspo_lora_attention_enabled\", False) if sam_cfg else False\n        gspo_lora_attention_momentum = getattr(sam_cfg, \"gspo_lora_attention_momentum\", 0.9) if sam_cfg else 0.9\n        allow_semisup = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"allow_semisup\", False) if gspo_cfg else False\n\n        try:\n            return GSPOConvLoRATrainer(\n                predictor=None,  # Not required by current implementation\n                group_size=getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_group_size\", 3),\n                warmup_epochs=getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_warmup_epochs\", 5),\n                contrastive_weight=getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_contrastive_weight\", 0.1),\n                quality_metric=\"iou\",\n                advantage_temperature=5.0,\n                lambda_smooth=lambda_smooth,\n                lambda_boundary=lambda_boundary,\n                w_boundary=w_boundary,\n                w_smooth=w_smooth,\n                w_thin=w_thin,\n                # GSPO-Adapter extension\n                gspo_adapter_enabled=gspo_adapter_enabled,\n                gspo_adapter_momentum=gspo_adapter_momentum,\n                # GSPO-LoRA on Attention extension (NEW)\n                gspo_lora_attention_enabled=gspo_lora_attention_enabled,\n                gspo_lora_attention_momentum=gspo_lora_attention_momentum,\n                allow_semisup=allow_semisup,\n            )\n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.warning(\"Failed to instantiate GSPOConvLoRATrainer: %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", e)\n            return None\n\n    def on_predict_start(self, data: pd.DataFrame):\n        data = self.data_to_df(data=data)\n        if self._output_shape is None:  # for zero-shot evaluation/prediction\n            self._output_shape = self.get_semantic_segmentation_class_num(data)\n        self.ensure_predict_ready()\n        return data\n    \n    def enable_tta(\n        self,\n        scales: List[float] = [0.75, 1.0, 1.25],\n        flips: List[str] = [\"none\", \"horizontal\"],\n        rotations: List[float] = [0],\n        fusion_method: str = \"mean\",\n        scale_weights: Optional[Dict[float, float]] = None,\n        threshold: float = 0.5,\n        min_area_ratio: float = 0.001,\n        use_morphology: bool = False,\n        resize_method: str = \"bilinear\",\n        cache_dir: Optional[str] = None,\n        resume_from_cache: bool = True,\n        box_prompt_mode: str = \"off\",\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Enable Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) for inference.\n        \n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        scales : List[float]\n            List of scale factors for multi-scale testing.\n            Recommended: [0.75, 1.0, 1.25] for fast (6 inferences).\n            Or [0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5] for better results.\n        flips : List[str]\n            List of flip types: \"none\", \"horizontal\", \"vertical\".\n            Recommended: [\"none\", \"horizontal\"] for most cases.\n        rotations : List[float]\n            List of rotation angles in degrees.\n            Recommended: [0] for fast, or [-10, 0, 10] for better (18 inferences).\n        fusion_method : str\n            Method to fuse predictions: \"mean\" or \"weighted_mean\".\n        scale_weights : Optional[Dict[float, float]]\n            Weights for each scale when using weighted_mean.\n        threshold : float\n            Threshold for binary segmentation (can be tuned on validation set).\n        min_area_ratio : float\n            Remove connected components with area &lt; min_area_ratio * image_area.\n        use_morphology : bool\n            Whether to apply morphological closing for smoothing.\n        resize_method : str\n            Resize interpolation method: \"bilinear\" or \"bicubic\".\n            Recommended: \"bilinear\" for speed, \"bicubic\" for quality.\n        cache_dir : Optional[str]\n            Directory to cache TTA predictions for resume (default: None, no caching).\n            Useful for long-running evaluations that might be interrupted.\n        resume_from_cache : bool\n            Whether to resume from cache if exists (default: True).\n        \n        Examples\n        --------\n        &gt;&gt;&gt; # Basic TTA (6 inferences)\n        &gt;&gt;&gt; predictor.enable_tta()\n        \n        &gt;&gt;&gt; # Advanced TTA (18 inferences)\n        &gt;&gt;&gt; predictor.enable_tta(\n        ...     scales=[0.75, 1.0, 1.25],\n        ...     flips=[\"none\", \"horizontal\"],\n        ...     rotations=[-10, 0, 10],\n        ...     fusion_method=\"weighted_mean\",\n        ...     resize_method=\"bicubic\"\n        ... )\n        \"\"\"\n        self._tta_predictor = TTAPredictor(\n            scales=scales,\n            flips=flips,\n            rotations=rotations,\n            fusion_method=fusion_method,\n            scale_weights=scale_weights,\n            threshold=threshold,\n            min_area_ratio=min_area_ratio,\n            use_morphology=use_morphology,\n            resize_method=resize_method,\n        )\n        \n        # Store cache configuration\n        self._tta_cache_dir = cache_dir\n        self._tta_resume_from_cache = resume_from_cache\n        self._tta_box_prompt_mode = box_prompt_mode\n        \n        logger.info(f\"TTA enabled with {len(self._tta_predictor.transforms)} augmentations\")\n        if cache_dir:\n            logger.info(f\"TTA caching enabled: {cache_dir} (resume={resume_from_cache})\")\n    \n    def disable_tta(self):\n        \"\"\"Disable Test-Time Augmentation.\"\"\"\n        self._tta_predictor = None\n        logger.info(\"TTA disabled\")\n\n    def evaluate(\n        self,\n        data: Union[pd.DataFrame, dict, list, str],\n        metrics: Optional[Union[str, List[str]]] = None,\n        return_pred: Optional[bool] = False,\n        realtime: Optional[bool] = False,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Evaluate model on a test dataset.\n\n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        data\n            A dataframe, containing the same columns as the training data.\n            Or a str, that is a path of the annotation file for detection.\n        metrics\n            A list of metric names to report.\n            If None, we only return the score for the stored &#96;_eval_metric_name&#96;.\n        return_pred\n            Whether to return the prediction result of each row.\n        realtime\n            Whether to do realtime inference, which is efficient for small data (default False).\n            If provided None, we would infer it on based on the data modalities\n            and sample number.\n\n        Returns\n        -------\n        A dictionary with the metric names and their corresponding scores.\n        Optionally return a dataframe of prediction results.\n        \"\"\"\n        data = self.on_predict_start(data)\n        return self.evaluate_semantic_segmentation(data, metrics, realtime)\n\n    def predict(\n        self,\n        data: Union[pd.DataFrame, dict, list, str],\n        realtime: Optional[bool] = False,\n        save_results: Optional[bool] = None,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Predict values for the label column of new data.\n\n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        data\n            The data to make predictions for. Should contain same column names as training data and\n            follow same format (except for the &#96;label&#96; column).\n        realtime\n            Whether to do realtime inference, which is efficient for small data (default False).\n            If provided None, we would infer it on based on the data modalities\n            and sample number.\n        save_results\n            Whether to save the prediction results.\n\n        Returns\n        -------\n        Array of predictions, one corresponding to each row in given dataset.\n        When save_results is True, the output is a pandas dataframe containing the path of the predicted mask file for each input image.\n        Otherwise, the output will have shape (#samples, height, width).\n        \"\"\"\n        data = self.on_predict_start(data)\n        if self._output_shape == 1:\n            ret_type = LOGITS\n        else:\n            ret_type = SEMANTIC_MASK\n\n        outputs = self.predict_per_run(\n            data=data,\n            realtime=realtime,\n            requires_label=False,\n        )\n\n        logits = self.post_process_prediction(data, outputs, ret_type)\n\n        pred = []\n        for logit in logits:\n            logit = logit.numpy()\n            if ret_type == SEMANTIC_MASK:\n                pred.append(logit.argmax(axis=1))\n            else:\n                pred.append((logit &gt; 0.5).squeeze(axis=1))\n\n        if save_results:\n            self._save_path = setup_save_path(\n                old_save_path=self._save_path,\n                warn_if_exist=False,\n            )\n            pred = self.save_segmentation_result(\n                pred=pred,\n                data=data,\n                result_path=self._save_path,\n            )\n\n        return pred\n\n        # if (as_pandas is None and isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame)) or as_pandas is True:\n        #     # TODO\n        #     pred = self._as_pandas(data=data, to_be_converted=pred)\n\n    def predict_proba(\n        self,\n        data: Union[pd.DataFrame, dict, list],\n        as_pandas: Optional[bool] = None,\n        as_multiclass: Optional[bool] = True,\n        realtime: Optional[bool] = False,\n        **kwargs,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"\n        Predict probabilities class probabilities rather than class labels.\n        This is only for the classification. Calling it for regression will throw an exception.\n\n        Parameters\n        ----------\n        data\n            The data to make predictions for. Should contain same column names as training data and\n              follow same format (except for the &#96;label&#96; column).\n        as_pandas\n            Whether to return the output as a pandas DataFrame(Series) (True) or numpy array (False).\n        as_multiclass\n            Whether to return the probability of all labels or\n            just return the probability of the positive \n        # Complete Sanity Check 3: Test TTA on first image\n        try:\n            test_img_pil = Image.open(test_img_path)\n            test_img = np.array(test_img_pil)\n            test_img_pil.close()\n            \n            if len(test_img.shape) == 2:\n                test_img = np.stack([test_img] * 3, axis=2)\n            \n            logger.info(f\"    Image shape: {test_img.shape}\")\n            \n            # Test TTA prediction\n            test_pred_mask, test_pred_prob = self._tta_predictor.predict_with_tta(\n                test_img, predict_fn, return_probs=True\n            )\n            \n            logger.info(f\"    Output shape: {test_pred_prob.shape}\")\n            \n            # Verify output shape matches input\n            assert test_pred_prob.shape[:2] == test_img.shape[:2], \\\n                f\"❌ Output shape mismatch! Expected {test_img.shape[:2]}, got {test_pred_prob.shape[:2]}\"\n            \n            logger.info(f\"  ✓ TTA pipeline test PASSED!\")\n            \n            # Clean up test data\n            del test_img, test_pred_mask, test_pred_prob\n            \n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"❌ Sanity check FAILED! Starting full evaluation...\\n\")\n        \n        # ============================================================\n        # 方案 2: 断点续传机制\n        # ============================================================\n        import os\n        import pickle\n        \n        # Setup cache directory\n        processed_indices = set()\n        all_preds = []\n        all_labels = []\n        cache_file = None\n        processed_indices_file = None\n        \n        if cache_dir is not None:\n            os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True)\n            cache_file = os.path.join(cache_dir, \"tta_predictions.pkl\")\n            processed_indices_file = os.path.join(cache_dir, \"processed_indices.txt\")\n            \n            # Try to load cached data\n            if resume_from_cache and os.path.exists(cache_file):\n                try:\n                    logger.info(f\"📂 Loading cached predictions from {cache_file}\")\n                    with open(cache_file, 'rb') as f:\n                        cache_data = pickle.load(f)\n                        all_preds = cache_data['preds']\n                        all_labels = cache_data['labels']\n                        processed_indices = set(cache_data['indices'])\n                    logger.info(f\"✅ Loaded {len(all_preds)} cached predictions (resuming from checkpoint)\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    logger.warning(f\"⚠️  Failed to load cache: {e}. Starting fresh.\")\n                    processed_indices = set()\n                    all_preds = []\n                    all_labels = []\n            else:\n                if cache_dir:\n                    logger.info(f\"💾 Caching enabled. Predictions will be saved to {cache_dir}\")\n        \n        # Initialize metrics early so we can stream updates and avoid storing all predictions\n        metric_objects = {}\n        if isinstance(metrics, str):\n            metrics = [metrics]\n        for per_metric_name in metrics:\n            metric_objects[per_metric_name] = get_metric_predict(\n                metric_name=per_metric_name.lower(),\n                num_classes=self._output_shape\n            )\n\n        # Determine whether to stream metrics (no caching =&gt; no large tensors kept)\n        streaming_metrics = cache_dir is None\n\n        # Process each image with TTA\n        import time\n        import gc\n        start_time = time.time()\n        total_images = len(data)\n\n        for idx, row in data.iterrows():\n            # ⭐ 跳过已处理的样本（断点续传）\n            if idx in processed_indices:\n                logger.info(f\"⏭️  Skipping image {idx+1}/{total_images} (already processed)\")\n                continue\n\n            img_start = time.time()\n\n            # Load image and label\n            image_path = row['image']\n            label_path = row['label'] if 'label' in row else None\n\n            # Load image with proper resource management\n            img_pil = Image.open(image_path)\n            image = np.array(img_pil)\n            img_pil.close()  # Release file handle\n\n            if len(image.shape) == 2:\n                image = np.stack([image] * 3, axis=2)  # Convert grayscale to RGB\n\n            # Load label if exists\n            label = None\n            gt_box = None\n            if label_path:\n                label_pil = Image.open(label_path)\n                label = np.array(label_pil)\n                label_pil.close()  # Release file handle\n\n                if len(label.shape) == 3:\n                    label = label[:, :, 0]  # Take first channel if RGB\n\n                # Binarize label: convert [0, 255] to [0, 1]\n                # This matches the preprocessing in semantic_seg_metrics.py\n                if self._output_shape == 1:  # Binary segmentation\n                    label = (label &gt; 128).astype(np.int64)\n\n                if not streaming_metrics:\n                    all_labels.append(torch.from_numpy(label))\n\n                # Compute GT bounding box (single box per sample, original coords)\n                ys, xs = np.where(label &gt; 0)\n                if xs.size &gt; 0 and ys.size &gt; 0:\n                    gt_box = np.array([xs.min(), ys.min(), xs.max(), ys.max()], dtype=np.float32)\n\n            # If predicted boxes are provided in DataFrame, override gt_box\n            if {\"bbox_x1\", \"bbox_y1\", \"bbox_x2\", \"bbox_y2\"}.issubset(row.index):\n                vals = [row[\"bbox_x1\"], row[\"bbox_y1\"], row[\"bbox_x2\"], row[\"bbox_y2\"]]\n                if not any([v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and np.isnan(v)) for v in vals]):\n                    gt_box = np.array(vals, dtype=np.float32)\n\n            # Predict with TTA\n            if self._output_shape == 1:\n                # Binary segmentation\n                pred_mask, pred_prob = self._tta_predictor.predict_with_tta(\n                    image, predict_fn, return_probs=True, box_prompt=gt_box, box_ref_shape=image.shape[:2]\n                )\n                pred_tensor = torch.from_numpy(pred_prob)\n                if not streaming_metrics:\n                    # Store only when caching/resume is enabled\n                    all_preds.append(pred_tensor)\n                # Free memory\n                del pred_mask, pred_prob\n            else:\n                # Multi-class segmentation\n                _, pred_prob = self._tta_predictor.predict_with_tta(\n                    image, predict_fn, return_probs=True, box_prompt=gt_box, box_ref_shape=image.shape[:2]\n                )\n                pred_tensor = torch.from_numpy(pred_prob)\n                if not streaming_metrics:\n                    all_preds.append(pred_tensor)\n                # Free memory\n                del pred_prob\n\n            # Stream metric updates to avoid holding all predictions in memory\n            if streaming_metrics:\n                y_p = pred_tensor.float()\n                if label is None:\n                    raise ValueError(\"Labels are required for evaluation\")\n                y_t = torch.from_numpy(label)\n                y_t = y_t.long() if y_t.dtype != torch.long else y_t\n\n                # Resize prediction to match label size if needed\n                if y_p.shape[-2:] != y_t.shape[-2:]:\n                    target_size = y_t.shape[-2:]\n                    y_p = F.interpolate(\n                        y_p.unsqueeze(0),\n                        size=target_size,\n                        mode='bilinear',\n                        align_corners=False\n                    ).squeeze(0)\n\n                for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                    metric_obj.update(y_p.unsqueeze(0), y_t.unsqueeze(0))\n\n            # Free image and label memory\n            del image\n            if label is not None:\n                del label\n\n            # ⭐ 标记为已处理（断点续传）\n            processed_indices.add(idx)\n\n            img_time = time.time() - img_start\n\n            if idx == 0:\n                logger.info(f\"First image processed in {img_time:.2f}s (includes warmup)\")\n\n            # ⭐ 定期保存缓存（每 10 张图或最后一张）\n            num_processed = len(processed_indices)\n            if (not streaming_metrics) and cache_file is not None and (num_processed % 10 == 0 or num_processed == total_images):\n                try:\n                    logger.info(f\"💾 Saving checkpoint ({num_processed}/{total_images} images)\")\n                    with open(cache_file, 'wb') as f:\n                        pickle.dump({\n                            'preds': all_preds,\n                            'labels': all_labels,\n                            'indices': list(processed_indices)\n                        }, f)\n\n                    # Save processed indices as text file (for easy inspection)\n                    with open(processed_indices_file, 'w') as f:\n                        f.write('\\n'.join(map(str, sorted(processed_indices))))\n\n                    logger.info(f\"✅ Checkpoint saved successfully\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    logger.warning(f\"⚠️  Failed to save checkpoint: {e}\")\n\n            # More aggressive garbage collection to prevent memory leaks\n            if (idx + 1) % 5 == 0:  # Every 5 images instead of 10\n                gc.collect()  # Force garbage collection\n                if torch.cuda.is_available():\n                    torch.cuda.empty_cache()  # Clear GPU cache\n\n            # Progress logging\n            if (idx + 1) % 10 == 0 or num_processed == total_images:\n                elapsed = time.time() - start_time\n                avg_time = elapsed / num_processed if num_processed &gt; 0 else 0\n                remaining = total_images - num_processed\n                eta = avg_time * remaining if remaining &gt; 0 else 0\n                logger.info(\n                    f\"Processed {num_processed}/{total_images} images with TTA \"\n                    f\"(avg: {avg_time:.2f}s/img, ETA: {eta/60:.1f}min)\"\n                )\n\n                # ⭐ 中间指标：在评估过程中周期性输出当前已处理样本的指标\n                # 说明：\n                # - 仅在 streaming_metrics=True（即未开启 cache_dir，走低内存流式评估）时启用\n                # - 使用 torchmetrics.compute() 不会清空内部状态，因此可以安全多次调用\n                if streaming_metrics:\n                    try:\n                        intermediate_results = {}\n                        for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                            score = metric_obj.compute()\n                            # score 可能是 tensor 或数值，这里统一为 float 便于日志展示\n                            if hasattr(score, \"item\"):\n                                score = score.item()\n                            intermediate_results[metric_name] = float(score)\n                        if intermediate_results:\n                            logger.info(\n                                f\"Intermediate TTA metrics after {num_processed} images: \"\n                                f\"{intermediate_results}\"\n                            )\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        logger.warning(f\"Failed to compute intermediate metrics: {e}\")\n        \n        # Final garbage collection\n        gc.collect()\n        if torch.cuda.is_available():\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n\n        logger.info(f\"Finished processing all {len(data)} images, computing metrics...\")\n\n        results = {}\n        if streaming_metrics:\n            # Metrics were updated on the fly; just compute\n            for metric_name, metric_obj in metric_objects.items():\n                score = metric_obj.compute()\n                results[metric_name] = score.item()\n        else:\n            # Check that we have predictions and labels\n            if len(all_labels) == 0:\n                raise ValueError(\"Labels are required for evaluation\")\n            \n            if len(all_preds) != len(all_labels):\n                raise ValueError(f\"Number of predictions ({len(all_preds)}) != number of labels ({len(all_labels)})\")\n\n            # Process each image individually (can't stack due to different sizes)\n            for y_p, y_t in zip(all_preds, all_labels):\n                # Ensure predictions and labels are on CPU and have matching sizes\n                y_p = y_p.float()\n                y_t = y_t.long() if y_t.dtype != torch.long else y_t\n                \n                # Resize prediction to match label size if needed\n                if y_p.shape[-2:] != y_t.shape[-2:]:\n                    target_size = y_t.shape[-2:]\n                    y_p = F.interpolate(\n metric_obj.compute()\n                results[metric_name] = score.item()\n\n        logger.info(f\"TTA evaluation completed: {results}\")\n        \n        # ⭐ 清理缓存文件（评估成功完成后）\n        if cache_file         os.remove(processed_indices_file)\n                logger.info(f\"🗑️  Cleaned up cache files (evaluation completed successfully)\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.warning(f\"⚠️  Failed to clean up cache: {e}\")\n        \n        # Free memory\n        del all_preds, all_labels, metric_objects\n        gc.collect()\n        if torch.cuda.is_available():\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n        \n        if return_pred:\n            logger.warning(\"return_pred=True not fully supported with TTA (memory optimization)\")\n            return results, []\n        else:\n            return results\n\n    def get_litmodule_per_run(\n        self,\n        model=None,\n        model_postprocess_fn=None,\n        peft_param_names=None,\n        optim_kwargs=None,\n        distillation_kwargs=None,\n        is_train=True,\n    ):\n        gspo_trainer = None\n        if is_train:\n            gspo_trainer = self._maybe_create_gspo_trainer()\n        if is_train:\n            return SemanticSegmentationLitModule(\n                model=model,\n                model_postprocess_fn=model_postprocess_fn,\n                trainable_param_names=peft_param_names,\n                gspo_trainer=gspo_trainer,\n                train_box_prompt_cfg=self._train_box_prompt_cfg,\n                train_bbox_predictor=self._train_bbox_predictor,\n                **optim_kwargs,\n            )\n        else:\n            return SemanticSegmentationLitModule(\n                model=self._model,\n             **optim_kwargs,\n            )\n\n    def _maybe_create_gspo_trainer(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Auto-create GSPO trainer if the config enables GSPO.\n        The trainer \"lora\", None)\n        if not lora_cfg or not getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_enabled\", False):\n            return None\n\n        gspo_cfg = getattr(self._config.optim, \"gspo\", None)\n        lambda_smooth = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"lambda_smooth\", 0.1) if gspo_cfg else 0.1\n        lambda_boundary = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"lambda_boundary\", 0.3) if gspo_cfg else 0.3\n        w_boundary = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"w_boundary\", 0.3) if gspo_cfg else 0.3\n        w_smooth = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"w_smooth\", 0.1) if gspo_cfg else 0.1\n        w_thin = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"w_thin\", 0.05) if gspo_cfg else 0.05\n\n        # Dynamically load GSPOConvLoRATrainer from examples path.\n        examples_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / \"examples\" / \"automm\" / \"Conv-LoRA\" / \"gspo_trainer.py\"\n        if not examples_root.exists():\n            logger.warning(\"GSPO is enabled but gspo_trainer.py not found at %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", examples_root)\n            return None\n\n        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"autogluon_multimodal.gspo_trainer\", examples_root)\n        if spec is None or spec.loader is None:\n            logger.warning(\"Failed to load GSPO trainer spec from %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", examples_root)\n            return None\n        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n        spec.loader.exec_module(module)  # type: ignore\n        GSPOConvLoRATrainer = getattr(module, \"GSPOConvLoRATrainer\", None)\n        if GSPOConvLoRATrainer is None:\n            logger.warning(\"GSPOConvLoRATrainer not found in %s; GSPO will be skipped.\", examples_root)\n            return None\n\n        # Get GSPO-Adapter parameters (if available)\n        sam_cfg = getattr(self._config.model, \"sam\", None)\n        gspo_adapter_enabled = getattr(sam_cfg, \"adapter_gspo_enabled\", False) if sam_cfg else False\n        gspo_adapter_momentum = getattr(sam_cfg, \"adapter_gspo_momentum\", 0.9) if sam_cfg else 0.9\n        \n        # Get GSPO-LoRA on Attention parameters (if available) - NEW\n        gspo_lora_attention_enabled = getattr(sam_cfg, \"gspo_lora_attention_enabled\", False) if sam_cfg else False\n        gspo_lora_attention_momentum = getattr(sam_cfg, \"gspo_lora_attention_momentum\", 0.9) if sam_cfg else 0.9\n        allow_semisup = getattr(gspo_cfg, \"allow_semisup\", False) if gspo_cfg else False\n\n        try:\n            return GSPOConvLoRATrainer(\n                predictor=None,  # Not required by current implementation\n                group_size=getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_group_size\", 3),\n                warmup_epochs=getattr(lora_cfg, \"gspo_warmup_epochs\", 5),\n
